methods.name: getBogieCount
methods.description: Gets the number of bogies this train has.

methods.name: getBogieMatrix

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index goes from front of the train to the back. 0 <= index < getBogieCount().

parameters.name: m
parameters.description: The result is stored in this transformation matrix.

methods.description: Gets the bogie's orientation and position as a transformation matrix.

methods.name: getBogieOrientationAndPosition

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index goes from front of the train to the back. 0 <= index < getBogieCount().

parameters.name: frontOut
parameters.description: frontOut can be null if no front vector is requested.

parameters.name: topOut
parameters.description: topOut can be null if no top vector is requested.

parameters.name: rightOut
parameters.description: rightOut can be null if no right-unit vector is requested.

parameters.name: posOut
parameters.description: posOut can be null if no position vector is requested.

methods.description: Gets the bogie's orientation unit vectors and position vector.

methods.name: getCoaster
methods.description: Returns the coaster this block belongs to.

methods.name: getHarnessState
methods.description: Returns the state of the harnesses (0...1).
methods.returnDescription: 0 means fully closed and 1 means fully opened.

methods.name: getOnboardStreamedSound
methods.description: Returns the currently onboard streamed sound.

methods.description: Returns the current speed of the train in meters per second.

methods.name: getTrainIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the train, starting from 0 for the first train.

methods.description: Returns the lashed to track state.
